text:
Artificial intelligence is changing the world around us, from how we shop to how we receive medical care. However, this rapid growth brings serious ethical questions that we cannot ignore. One major problem is bias. If an AI system learns from biased data, it can make unfair decisions, such as rejecting a loan application based on race or gender. This is why fairness must be a priority.

Another crucial issue is privacy. AI often collects vast amounts of personal information. We need clear rules about what data can be used and how it is protected. Additionally, transparency is essential—users should understand how AI makes decisions that affect their lives.

Ultimately, responsible AI development requires open discussions and strong safeguards. We must build technology that serves everyone fairly, protects individuals, and earns public trust.
